description:
Physical guiding is too disgusting for him, so he stubbornly insists on only doing radiant guiding. The problem child S-class guide Baek Su-Won. Having repeatedly knocked out the espers who attacked him, Su-Won now faces expulsion from the association... As a last chance, he's assigned to guide S-class esper Gong Ian on a business trip. But they say things go wrong from the start with someone incompatible. As luck would have it, Ian was the sexual harasser who rubbed himself against Su-Won on the bus. Somehow, Su-Won ends up bound by the worst possible contract: a month of ‘live-in guiding’.

But... This guy just gets more excited the more he gets hit... He's definitely not normal!

 *“Su-Won, you know what? I wanna die... for you♥”*

Can Su-Won really endure a month of physical guidance from Ian?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
